locale.description: BCP 47 language tag of this catalog, used for document language, numbers and plural rules.

extensionDescription.message: Keep Thunderbird running in the Linux system tray, with unread badges and new-mail notifications.

optionsIntro.message: Keep your mail close, and your desktop clear.

settingEnabledDescription.message: Keep Thunderbird running when its main windows are hidden.

settingCloseDescription.message: The window’s close button sends it to the tray.

settingMinimizeDescription.message: Thunderbird’s minimize button sends mail windows to the tray.

settingUnreadDescription.message: A combined count across your mail accounts. Large totals display as 99+.

settingNotificationsDescription.message: Off by default. A quiet heads-up, without sender names or message subjects.

helpTitle.message: A home in your top bar

helpRestore.message: Use the tray icon or its Show Thunderbird menu item to bring your mail back. On GNOME, a single click may open the menu; double-click or middle-click restores the window.

helpQuit.message: Choose Quit Thunderbird in the tray, or use Thunderbird’s usual Quit command, to exit completely. Compose windows and unsaved drafts keep their normal behavior.

helpSetup.message: This add-on needs the companion tray helper and an active GNOME AppIndicator extension. Follow the README included with your download to install the helper.

helpRecovery.message: If the helper or tray is unavailable, windows keep their normal behavior. Hidden windows are restored automatically if the connection is lost.

helpWayland.message: On Wayland, desktop-level minimize shortcuts may minimize normally. Use Thunderbird’s minimize button, close button, or “Send to tray” for background mode.

helpNotifications.message: To avoid duplicate alerts, turn off Thunderbird’s built-in “Show an alert” option in its incoming-mail settings. This add-on does not change that preference.

helpUnread.message: The badge excludes Junk, Trash, Sent, Drafts, Templates, Outbox, their subfolders, and duplicate virtual folders. It updates as Thunderbird syncs your mail.

privacyFooter.message: Local by design. No telemetry, accounts, or cloud service.

backgroundUnavailable.message: The add-on background page is unavailable.

statusDisabledDescription.message: Thunderbird windows close and minimize normally.

statusInstallHelper.message: Install the helper to get started.

notificationRequested.message: Notification requested. Your desktop’s notification preferences apply.

trayRequired.message: A working tray is required before hiding Thunderbird.

unreadPartial.message: Some folders could not be counted. The badge shows a partial total.

unreadUnavailable.message: Unread count is temporarily unavailable. It will be retried automatically.

notificationTest.message: Notifications are ready. Click to show Thunderbird.

notificationNewMessageOne.message: $COUNT$ new message. Click to show Thunderbird.

notificationNewMessageOther.message: $COUNT$ new messages. Click to show Thunderbird.

notificationFailed.message: The desktop could not show a notification. Check your notification settings.

helperTimeout.message: The tray helper stopped responding. Windows have been restored.

helperVersionMismatch.message: Tray helper version mismatch. Reinstall the helper.

helperConnectionError.message: Could not communicate with the tray helper: $ERROR$

helperDesktopLost.message: The tray helper lost its desktop connection.

helperTrayMissing.message: No system tray found. Enable GNOME AppIndicator support.

helperTrayLost.message: The desktop tray is unavailable. Windows have been restored.

helperTrayInactive.message: A tray watcher exists, but no desktop tray is active.

helperContactFailed.message: Could not contact the desktop tray. Retrying automatically.

helperReady.message: Connected to the desktop tray. Thunderbird can run in the background.

helperRegistrationFailed.message: Could not register the tray icon. Retrying automatically.

helperWaiting.message: Waiting for the desktop tray. Enable GNOME AppIndicator support.

helperDependencies.message: Install Python 3 PyGObject and GLib/GdkPixbuf introspection (python3-gi, gir1.2-glib-2.0, gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0 on Debian/Ubuntu).

helperSessionBus.message: Unable to connect to the desktop session bus. Start Thunderbird inside your desktop session.

helperProtocolError.message: The tray helper could not process a message. Reinstall the helper and add-on together.
